gaps.what: Aram-Zobah: the Aram-Zobah page was opened but gives no year for Hadadezer, Rezon, Saul's or David's wars, the tribute to Israel or Solomon's accession, and no infobox span; no dossier written

Kition and the other Cyprus city-kingdoms of the Iron Age (Salamis, Paphos, Idalion, Tamassos): the Kition page was opened and is silent on territory, annexations of Idalion/Tamassos/Lapithos and Assyrian tribute; it gives only Tyrian rule from the 10th century, Egyptian rule 570-545, Persian rule from 545, the Ionian revolt of 499 and Ptolemy I's conquest in 312 BC; no dossier written
Mukish/Alalakh, Nuhashshe, Kadesh and the other Syrian city-states of the hittites ledger have no dossier
Awsan's second kingdom (2nd and 1st centuries BC) has no extent on any page opened; only the first kingdom (-750..-625) is written
Judah's control of Edom (the Judah page's undated references) is not drawn
Siyannu is undated and unplaced on the pages opened
Persian-period status of Moab, Edom and Ammon after the Babylonian conquest is bridged or missing; the achaemenid-empire group (me-05) should check
David-era vassalages of Moab, Ammon, Edom and Aram are carried only by the kingdom-of-israel dossier (me-04-a), not mirrored here
Sam'al's annexation of Ya'udi and its gains from Carchemish, Quwe and Adana are undated on the page and not drawn; the Ya'udi and Quwe/Hiyawa kingdoms have no dossier
Tarhuntassa's site and borders are unknown; the shape is a placeholder from the proposed sites

problems: OVERLAPS WITH CLIOPATRIA HULLS: the Neo-Hittite states row (me-04-a, -1150..-801, widened there to -1180..-717) holds the same land as carchemish, bit-agusi, sam-al, gurgum and kummuh, and part of kammanu; the carchemish and bit-agusi events duplicate events already in the neo-hittite-states dossier (Carchemish's tribute from -868 and fall in -717; Arpad's loss in -740). The renderer needs one rule: draw the sub-states and drop the hull for the same cells, or keep the hull.

Cliopatria's Neo-Assyrian (-700), Neo-Babylonian and Achaemenid shapes contain the Moab, Ammon and Edom land and the Jawf and Negev land of Qedar; draw these states as tinted tributaries where they fall inside.

CONFLICTS WITH THE HITTITES DOSSIER (me-04-a): it draws the Cilician lands as Hittite from -1400 while kizzuwatna runs to -1350; it draws Carchemish as direct Hittite land in the -1300 shape although the Carchemish page treats it as a vassal kingdom, and gives 1327 for the Carchemish conquest against 1345 here (the infobox says c. 1321); it ends Amurru's vassalage in -1180 against the page's -1200; its -1345 'syrian-city-states' gain reads with qatna's -1337; it has no events for Kaska, Isuwa, Hayasa-Azzi after Ganuvara or Tarhuntassa.

PAGES THAT FAILED: Benteshina, Bentesina and Mesha_(king_of_Moab) (Amurru and Moab, three retries, not loaded); Gurgum_(kingdom) does not exist (the article is Gurgum); Kaska_people is the Kaska Dena of British Columbia (the article is Kaskians).
Eight resolve warnings on awsan: the region name 'Awsan' is absent from the gazetteer (the sabaeans, qataban and hadhramaut dossiers use it too).

Capital coordinates were not on several pages; placeholders are used (Kummanni at Adana, Sumur at Tartus, Dibon at Dhiban, Bozrah at Buseirah, Ura at Bayburt, Hajar Yahirr at 'Ataq, Isuwa at Elazig, Alashiya at Famagusta, Kummuh at Adiyaman, Tarhuntassa at Konya, Kaska at the Pontus centre); each is flagged in its capital note.

Counterparts missing when written: kingdom-of-urartu (eu-19) and nabataeans have no dossier yet in history/polities/ (nabataeans has a Cliopatria row, -164..105). The neo-assyrian-empire dossier (me-02) has no events for Qedar, Sam'al, Gurgum, Kummuh or Kammanu (its only Arab tribute is the Mu'na after 734), so the matching vassal and loss events here have no mirror there.

Thin sources: most states in this batch rest on one to five pages; many events are confidence 1 or 2 and the shapes are provincial or circle readings (soft certainty). The Syro-Hittite states page gave no dates at all.
